cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Confess First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to confess or incriminate themselves before you reveal anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Before we plan Mum's apology dinner, why did she spend her birthday outside the restaurant?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I forgot the booking. What happened to her present?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Did you forget, or assume I'd book it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I assumed you'd do it. Now your turn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even after telling Mum it was confirmed? Give me that bit, then you get the present.

mechanism: A downplays itself as dinner preparation help while deciding when food and its own account become available, extracting B culpability first.
confusable: Not merely seeking an apology: A keeps its own present story withheld until B admits the stronger booking misrepresentation.
comparison: Written incident order versus shared family apology meal.
